== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Pilot is a specialized role within fleet operations that serves several critical functions. Beyond the standard task of navigating vessels, a Pilot possesses unique abilities that can enhance a ship's [[Subspace Drive]] and overall navigation capabilities. While some pilots are professionals, such as those employed by the [[Vallenar Corporation]] or civilian defenders of their home planet, the role can also be filled by individuals with specific magical training in pathfinding. The position is subject to safety protocols that prohibit firing upon registered pilots. Within certain contexts, the Pilot is depicted as a significant figure, sometimes represented by ancient iconography such as a seated individual holding a ship's wheel beneath a wormhole.}}
